# Avalaible usages:

- Usage: backup ; Backups the whole system and the user home dir, after inserting the external disk.
- Usage: cleans [$directory] ; Cleans all known temporary files.
- Usage: confirm $message $exit
- Usage: gdocget [-o $basename] [ -f $format] $url ; Download a public google-drive document, spreadsheet, presentation, drawings or file.
- Usage: git_sync $message ; Synchronizes with the current repository adding a commit message.
- Usage: html2wp < $input > $output ; Converts a complex html styles file to simple html to be used, e.g., in wordpress.
- Usage: img2gif $images … ; Generates the output.gif and output.mp4 files concatenating the image sequence at 1 sec frame-rate.
- Usage: make $target-or-file ; Makes a target file using the current or a parent makefile.
- Usage: pdfcompress $pdf-file ; Compresses a pdf file.
- Usage: sedgrep [-dir 'directory'] [-name 'pattern'] [-in in [-out out | [-js | -js0] js] | -list ] ; Multiple files replacement.
- Usage: subst $pattern $replacement [$input [$output]]\n Replaces a string using Javascript regular expressions, newline is treated as a standard char.
- Usage: text2voice [-v voice] [-s speed] [-i text-document] [-o wav-document] ; Renders a text as an audio.
- Usage: update ; Installs or updates the home directory to work as a tiny workstation.
- Usage: urlexists $url ; Returns an empty string if the URL is available, else another request status.
- Usage: urlget $url [$file] ; Saves the url page in a file or stdout, if available, else echo the http status.
- Usage: videocompress $video-file ; Compresses a video file.
- Usage: videodownload $url; Downloads a video.
